news.contents: Indianapolis kicker Spencer Shrader is still a quality fantasy kicker option even though his team has struggled to move the ball a ton this season. He has made 23 of his 25 field goals and is 19-of-20 on his extra points, so he's making nearly every kick he attempts. There's only been one game in which Shrader didn't get a field goal attempt, and he's attempted an extra point in every contest as well. In Week 11, he will go up against Houston, whom he is facing for the second time this season. ...
news.title: Spencer Shrader Remains Solid Option Despite Team's Struggles

news.contents: Jacksonville wide receiver and cornerback Travis Hunter has just deep-league fantasy appeal after Week 10. news.contents: Carolina Panthers head coach Dave Canales said that he believes running back Jonathon Brooks (abdomen) will be ready to return from Injured Reserve in Week 11 against the Baltimore Ravens, per Nick Carboni of WCNC Charlotte. Brooks has been sidelined since Week 2 after undergoing core muscle surgery. The 23-year-old has had an injury-ravaged NFL career to this point, appearing in just five games across three seasons since being selected by the Panthers in the second round of the 2024 draft. ...
